jobs.title: Manager US Commercial FP&A
jobs.description:
**Internal Candidate Identified**

About Zoetis
Zoetis is a global animal health company dedicated to supporting customers and their businesses. Building on more than 60 years of experience, Zoetis delivers quality medicines and vaccines, complemented by diagnostic products and genetic tests and supported by a range of services. As the world's leading animal health company, Zoetis is committed to making a difference for animals, people, and the communities we serve.
About the Role
We are seeking a Manager, U.S. FP&A, to join the Global Commercial Finance organization. Reporting to the Finance Lead, U.S. FP&A, this role will lead financial planning, performance management, reporting, and decision support for the U.S. Commercial business.
The Manager will serve as a finance subject matter expert and strategic business partner to senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders. This role will translate complex financial and operational information into clear insights, challenge assumptions constructively, and influence decisions across Finance, Commercial, Operations, and global teams.
The role will solve complex FP&A problems within the U.S. Commercial Finance area and lead high-impact activities across the U.S. Commercial P&L, including revenue, gross margin, operating expenses, forecasting, Annual Operating Plan processes, financial modeling, data visualization, and continuous improvement. The Manager will also lead cross-functional initiatives that strengthen reporting, planning, controls, and the broader decision-making framework.
What You Will Do
U.S. Commercial Performance Management
- Lead the monitoring, analysis, and reporting of key performance indicators and business results across U.S. Commercial.

- Proactively identify performance trends, risks, opportunities, and challenges, and translate findings into clear recommendations for business and Finance leadership.

- Own regular and ad hoc reporting for revenue, gross margin, operating expenses, and other key P&L areas.

- Develop a clear understanding of the underlying business dynamics driving financial performance and communicate results in a concise, actionable manner.

- Prepare executive-level reports, presentations, and materials that support financial reviews, business decisions, and strategic initiatives.

Financial Planning, Forecasting, and Modeling
- Lead assigned portions of the forecast and Annual Operating Plan processes, including report generation, template management, submission review, and analysis across the P&L.

- Develop and maintain sophisticated financial models, trend analyses, scenario analyses, dashboards, and reporting tools to support planning and decision-making.

- Evaluate financial assumptions, challenge inputs constructively, and communicate the implications of alternative scenarios to senior stakeholders.

- Support the monthly close process by leading operating expense analysis and reviewing other assigned P&L line items.

- Prepare and coordinate materials for financial reviews with senior leadership, including explanations of actual results, forecast changes, and key business drivers.

- Ensure that planning and reporting outputs are accurate, complete, timely, and aligned with established Finance standards and business requirements.

Business Partnership and Cross-Functional Leadership
- Partner with U.S. Commercial, Operations, Finance, and global teams to provide transparency into financial performance and support informed decision-making.

- Act as a trusted finance advisor to stakeholders by connecting financial results with operational drivers, business priorities, and investment decisions.

- Lead cross-functional discussions that address performance gaps, clarify assumptions, and identify practical actions.

- Provide guidance to colleagues and project teams on FP&A processes, financial analysis, modeling, reporting, and business partnering.

- Lead or contribute to U.S. Operations and U.S. Commercial Finance initiatives that have impact across related functions and business processes.

Process Improvement, Data, and Financial Technology
- Lead continuous improvement of financial processes, planning workflows, tools, and reporting to improve efficiency, consistency, and decision support.

- Develop data visualization content that clearly and effectively communicates the story within the data.

- Promote standardization, automation, and improved data quality across reporting and planning processes.

- Partner with Finance, Technology, and business stakeholders to enhance financial systems, reporting capabilities, and management information.

- Use tools such as SAP, Oracle, ThinkCell, PowerPoint, Excel, Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Anaplan, and OneStream, as applicable, to analyze and communicate financial information.

- Lead assigned improvement projects from problem definition through implementation, stakeholder communication, and adoption.

Controls and Compliance
- Ensure compliance with established company internal controls, financial policies, and procedures.

- Maintain appropriate documentation, review processes, and control evidence for assigned FP&A activities.

- Identify control or process risks and coordinate appropriate remediation with Finance and business partners.

What You Will Bring
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.

- Typically seven to nine years of progressive experience in corporate financial planning and analysis, commercial finance, or a related finance function.

- Strong track record of business partnering and influencing decisions through financial and operational analysis.

- Deep understanding of FP&A fundamentals, including budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, financial modeling, P&L management, and performance reporting.

- Experience supporting commercial businesses and working across complex, global, or matrixed organizations.

- Advanced proficiency in financial modeling, Excel, PowerPoint, and FP&A tools.

- Experience developing dashboards, data visualizations, management reporting, and executive presentations.

- Strong working knowledge of financial systems and planning tools, such as SAP, Oracle, Anaplan, OneStream, Power BI, Tableau, SQL, or similar platforms.

- Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex financial concepts clearly to senior leaders and non-finance stakeholders.

- Strong project management skills, with the ability to lead multiple initiatives, manage competing priorities, and deliver high-quality results under tight timelines.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to think strategically, assess alternatives, and translate data into actionable insights.

- Ability to work autonomously, exercise sound judgment, and navigate an evolving, high-energy environment.

- Ability to build collaborative relationships and work effectively with peers, business partners, global teams, and senior stakeholders.

- High level of attention to detail and accuracy, with a focus on delivering reliable financial analysis and recommendations.

Preferred Qualifications
- MBA, CPA, CMA, or other relevant advanced education or professional certification.

- Experience in commercial FP&A, pharmaceutical, healthcare, animal health, or another complex global industry.

- Experience leading finance transformation, reporting automation, planning system implementation, or data visualization initiatives.

- Experience managing projects or providing guidance to analysts, peers, or cross-functional teams.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $128,560 – $155,000 Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the base pay target range for new hire salaries for the position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

This position is also eligible for short-term incentive compensation.
This position is also eligible for long-term incentives.

In addition to compensation, Zoetis offers a comprehensive benefits package that supports the physical, emotional and financial wellbeing of our colleagues and their families including healthcare and insurance benefits beginning on day one, a 401K plan with a match and profit-sharing contribution from Zoetis, and 4 weeks of vacation.

jobs.title: Finance Manager, Enabling Functions
jobs.description:
Role Description
The Manager Enabling Functions Finance will be part of the HQ Corporate Finance team and will report to the Director, Enabling Functions Finance. The job responsibilities will consist of the following, but not limited to:

Performance Monitoring, Analysis, and Reporting
- Monitor, track, evaluate, and report performance across designated enabling functions, proactively identifying issues, opportunities, and challenges.
- Prepare regular reporting for operating expenses and capital investments, performing analysis to explain underlying business dynamics and results. Maximize visualization and dashboarding capabilities to drive efficient and value-add analytics.
- Support finance team with close processes by analyzing operating expense lines and other P&L items; prepare materials for financial reviews with senior leadership.
- Assist with required forecasting and Annual Operating Plan (AOP) submission, including report generation, template management, and analysis of forecast submissions across all aspects of the P&L.

Business Partnership & Leadership Support
- Act as a key business partner to enabling function and leadership teams.
- Deliver timely executive presentations, materials, and insights to facilitate effective finance reviews and decision-making.
- Financial Planning & Insight Development
- Assist in developing and maintaining financial models, trends, scenario analyses, and dashboards to provide strategic insights and support business initiatives.
- Conduct in-depth cost modeling and scenario analyses for new initiatives, partnering closely with enabling function leaders.
- Data Visualization & Storytelling
- Develop impactful data visualization content to clearly and effectively convey financial and operational stories, highlighting the drivers, impacts, and opportunities embedded in the data.
- Controls, Reporting & Process Optimization
- Ensure compliance, strong controls, and adherence to finance policies across enabling functions.
- Foster continual improvement and support transformation initiatives, including implementation of technology solutions and finance process enhancements.

Educational requirements and job experience
- 5-7 years work experience in a corporation in a financial planning and analysis function with strong track records of business partnering
- Experience in FP&A, modeling and forecasting tools is required
- Undergraduate degree in finance, accounting or economics
- MBA or CPA is a plus

Key Skills & Competencies
- Proven track record of working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
- Ability to work in a collaborative and results-oriented team with focus on delivering high-quality, cross functional results within tight time constraints
- Ability to communicate effectively with all levels of management both written and verbally
- Exceptional attention to detail, organization and ability to multitask and prioritize deliverables, while maintaining strong time management skills
- Strong analytical background with strategic thinking capabilities
- Experience with visualizing data in Power BI required
- Ability to work independently with minimal direction from supervisor
- Strong relationship building skills in effort to become a trusted partner, interacting effectively across peers and internal stakeholders to provide financial guidance/insights in support of business operations
- Solid understanding of financial planning and analysis, accounting, financial systems, and processes (SAP, OneStream, Essbase, Anaplan)
- Strong working knowledge of spreadsheet software (EXCEL) and PowerPoint

jobs.title: Operational Excellence Manager
jobs.description:
Role Description

POSITION SUMMARY
The Operational Excellence (OpEx) Leader is a key individual contributor within the Kalamazoo Digital Transformation and Operational Excellence organization. The principal purpose of the role is to identify, initiate, and complete projects that drive business results. This involves strengthening the culture of continuous improvement and leading cross-functional teams through the rigorous application of Lean & Six Sigma methodologies to achieve measurable outcomes. This role supports the entire Kalamazoo site, partnering across all functions including Manufacturing, Quality, Laboratories, Warehouse, Supply Chain, and Finance to drive efficiency and eliminate waste. This position reports to the Senior Manager – Digital Transformation and Operational Excellence.
POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES
- Conduct process evaluations and implement improvements to enhance efficiency and reduce waste.
- Develop and manage Lean initiatives to improve system performance and efficiency.
- Monitor the effectiveness of implemented Lean processes and make necessary adjustments.
- Create and present reports on Lean initiatives and their impact to senior management.
- Achieve aggressive operational targets with delivery of significant financial benefit.
- Serve as a recognized expert to facilitate highly complex problem solving, value stream mapping and special data analysis as required.
- Network both internally and externally to exchange learning’s and ensure best practices are adopted throughout the operations.
- Coach and train site colleagues on Lean methodology.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE
- Certified Lean Six Sigma Black Belt.
- Minimum 5-10 years progressive work experience or equivalent in a business environment preferably manufacturing technical/engineering or supply chain management.
- Strong understanding of Lean methodologies and principles.
- Bachelor’s degree in STEM field.
- Demonstrated training and facilitation experience preferred.
- Experience in data analysis and visualization preferred.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS
- The work environment includes both office and manufacturing settings.
- Approximately 75% office-based and 25% walking/standing in manufacturing areas.
- May require use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) such as gloves, eye protection, and protective clothing as per GMP standards.
- Potential for limited domestic and/or international travel up to 5%.
- Colleague will work in a facility that manufactures Cephalosporins and must not be Cephalosporin sensitive.
